content: ntfy subscribe API (docs.ntfy.sh/subscribe/api, fetched 2026-08): consume as JSON stream (/json ndjson), SSE (/sse for EventSource), raw (/raw), WebSocket (/ws) - all equivalent payload. poll=1 one-shot read; since= duration|timestamp|msgid|all replays cached messages for offline catch-up; comma-separated multi-topic in one connection; server-side filters (priority=, tags=); keepalive events. JSON message: id,time,expires,event,topic,priority,tags,click,attachment(name,type,size,expires,url),title,message(+markdown,actions on receive). Multi-device same topic = fan-out broadcast (no per-member identity). No reply path in protocol.
